title: Replay Verification Result
description: Frozen v1.0 schema for the result produced by the replay verifier for a single AI inference receipt.

outcome.description: Top-level verification outcome. PASS = all checks pass. FAIL = schema valid but a governance/policy rule failed. ERROR = structural or hash integrity problem.

receipt_hash.description: receipt_hash from the verified receipt (as declared, not recomputed).

checks.description: Per-check boolean results. All must be true for PASS.

schema_valid.description: True if the receipt passes JSON Schema validation.

hash_valid.description: True if the recomputed receipt_hash matches the declared receipt_hash.

ledger_valid.description: True if prev_receipt_hash matches the hash of the preceding ledger entry (or null for the first entry).

policy_valid.description: True if the declared policy decision is reproducible from the declared output and policy_version. Null if policy reproduction is not supported for this policy_version.

artifact_bound.description: True if model_sha256 matches an approved registry entry for (model_id, model_version). Null if no registry is provided.

error_detail.description: Machine-readable error code or description when outcome is ERROR. Null otherwise.
